API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIAlertsAlert Subscription Resource Add Alert Subscription
Alert Subscription Resource Add Alert Subscription
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/alertSubscriptions

Adds a new alert subscription. .

Request
​
APPLICATION/JSON
BODY

Information about the alert subscription

id
int32

System-generated identifier for the alert subscription

description
string

Additional comments or information about the alert subscription

email
string

The email address of the alert recipient

pt0Severities
string[]

Lists the severity levels of the Patient 0 Alert class information that the recipient receives

Possible values: [CRITICAL, MAJOR, MINOR, INFO, DEBUG]

secureSeverities
string[]

Lists the severity levels of the Secure Alert class information that the recipient receives

Possible values: [CRITICAL, MAJOR, MINOR, INFO, DEBUG]

manageSeverities
string[]

Specifies the various severity levels

Possible values: [CRITICAL, MAJOR, MINOR, INFO, DEBUG]

complySeverities
string[]

Possible values: [CRITICAL, MAJOR, MINOR, INFO, DEBUG]

systemSeverities
string[]

Lists the severity levels of the System Alerts class information that the recipient receives

Possible values: [CRITICAL, MAJOR, MINOR, INFO, DEBUG]

deleted
boolean

Deletes an existing alert subscription

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

Example (auto)
